g.text: California Begins Discussion on Unlimited Film Incentives: ‘That Is a Heavy Lift’ ◆ Matthew Weiner Exits Peacock, 101 Studios Series ‘The Chairman’ Starring Eddie Murphy (EXCLUSIVE) ◆ Earl Barret, TV Writer and Co-Creator of ‘Too Close for Comfort,’ Dies at 94 ◆ Skydance’s JB Perrette Reveals His Full Leadership Team, Announces Departures of Several Execs Not Joining Following the Paramount-Warner Bros. Merger ◆ Byron Allen Earns Profit After Selling All the Starz Stock He Bought From Steven Mnuchin ◆ Patrick Stewart’s Career in Photos: ‘Star Trek,’ ‘X-Men,’ ‘Avengers: Doomsday’ and More ◆
